title: Three businesses. Three different website directions
summary: A showcase of distinctive small business websites. Explore each full preview to see how the layout, navigation and content change to suit a very different kind of business.
notice: These are fictional businesses created as examples of what DigiPixel can design. They are not customer case studies. Demo enquiry forms do not transmit information.

concepts.name: Alder & Stone
concepts.description: Industrial, high contrast and built around making it easy to request a quote.

concepts.name: Fieldnote
concepts.description: Quiet, editorial and information first, with an approachable service journey.

concepts.name: Sunday & Sage
concepts.description: Expressive, asymmetrical and photography led, with a completely different personality.
